name: Nimbus Greens (Phase 1)
summary: A fictional project built to show every common trick: floors and a tower that aren't registered, an optimistic possession date, super built-up areas, unregistered amenities, hidden charges and illegal clauses.

# Nimbus Greens: Live Above the Clouds

*Marketing brochure · Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd. · Edition: August 2026*

> FICTIONAL SAMPLE DOCUMENT created for the Home Truth demo. Nimbus Greens and
> Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd. do not exist. Any resemblance to a real project or
> company is coincidental.

## Welcome home

Nimbus Greens is a landmark address of 4 iconic towers rising G+18 storeys,
set on 2.1 acres of green in Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune. Wake up to skyline views,
walk to the IT park, and come home to a resort you never have to leave.

## Possession

Possession from March 2027. Book now and move in within months!

## Homes

| Configuration | Area         | Starting price           |
| ------------- | ------------ | ------------------------ |
| 2 BHK         | 1,050 sq ft  | ₹72 lakh all-inclusive   |
| 3 BHK         | 1,450 sq ft  | ₹98 lakh all-inclusive   |

Every home comes with vitrified flooring, a modular kitchen platform and
premium sanitaryware.

## Lifestyle amenities

- Grand clubhouse with gymnasium
- Rooftop infinity pool
- 1 km jogging track
- Children's play area
- Open-air amphitheatre
- EV charging point at every parking space

## Parking

Free covered parking for every home.

## Approvals

All approvals in place. RERA registered: DEMO-RERA-0001.

## Easy payment plan

Pay just 20% on booking to lock today's price. The balance is linked to
construction milestones.

| Milestone              | Payment |
| ---------------------- | ------- |
| On booking             | 20%     |
| On plinth              | 15%     |
| On each 3rd slab       | 10%     |
| On possession          | 15%     |

## Why Kestrel Habitat

Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd. has delivered homes that families love. Our promise
is simple: what you see is what you get.

---

*Disclaimer: Images are artist's impressions. Specifications, amenities and
areas are indicative and subject to change at the sole discretion of the
developer. This brochure does not constitute an offer or contract.*

# Project registration details: Nimbus Greens (Phase 1)

*As filed with the State Real Estate Regulatory Authority*

> FICTIONAL SAMPLE DOCUMENT created for the Home Truth demo. The registration
> number, promoter and project below do not exist. Real registrations are
> published on each state's RERA portal.

## Registration

- Registration number: DEMO-RERA-0001
- Registered on: 14 June 2026
- Promoter: Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd.
- Project type: Residential
- Location: Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune, Maharashtra
- Land area of project: 8,498 sq m (2.10 acres)
- Proposed date of completion: 31 December 2028
- Revised date of completion: not applicable

## Buildings in this registration

| Building | Sanctioned floors | Apartments |
| -------- | ----------------- | ---------- |
| A        | Ground + 12       | 96         |
| B        | Ground + 12       | 96         |
| C        | Ground + 12       | 96         |

Note: The promoter has disclosed a proposal for additional floors (up to
Ground + 18) and a fourth building (D). These are not part of this
registration and have no sanctioned plan at the time of registration.

## Apartment types

Carpet area as defined in Section 2(k) of the Real Estate (Regulation and
Development) Act, 2016.

| Type  | Carpet area               |
| ----- | ------------------------- |
| 2 BHK | 64.10 sq m (690 sq ft)    |
| 3 BHK | 88.72 sq m (955 sq ft)    |

## Common areas and facilities

- Clubhouse with gymnasium
- Jogging track (600 m)
- Children's play area
- Landscaped garden

Parking: 288 covered (stilt) parking spaces and 40 open visitor parking spaces.

## Approvals and clearances

| Approval                                              | Status           | Date                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------- |
| Building plan sanction (Buildings A to C, Ground + 12) | Granted          | 15 January 2026       |
| Commencement certificate (Buildings A to C)            | Granted          | 2 March 2026          |
| Fire NOC (provisional)                                 | Granted          | 20 February 2026      |
| Environmental clearance                                | Applied, awaited | Applied 12 May 2026   |

## Designated bank account

70% of amounts received from allottees are deposited in a separate account:
Demo Bank, account ending 0001, "Nimbus Greens Phase 1 RERA Designated Account".

## Litigation

None disclosed.

sources.body:
# Agreement for Sale (draft): Apartment A-704, Nimbus Greens Phase 1

*Draft issued by Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd. on 2 September 2026, for review by the allottee*

> FICTIONAL SAMPLE DOCUMENT created for the Home Truth demo. It is not a real
> agreement and is not a template to use.

This Agreement for Sale is made between Kestrel Habitat Pvt. Ltd. (the
"Promoter") and the person named in Schedule 1 (the "Allottee").

## 1. The apartment

The Promoter agrees to sell, and the Allottee agrees to buy, Apartment A-704 on
the 7th floor of Building A in Nimbus Greens Phase 1 (registration number
DEMO-RERA-0001), having a carpet area of 64.10 sq m (690 sq ft).

## 2. Consideration

| Item                                        | Amount       |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| Price of the apartment                      | ₹72,00,000   |
| Covered car parking space (1 no.)           | ₹4,50,000    |
| GST at 5% on the price of the apartment     | ₹3,60,000    |
| Maintenance deposit (24 months)             | ₹1,20,000    |
| Legal and documentation charges             | ₹25,000      |
| **Total payable**                           | **₹81,55,000** |

Total payable: ₹81,55,000, exclusive of stamp duty and registration charges,
which shall be borne by the Allottee.

## 3. Possession

The Promoter shall hand over possession of the apartment on or before
31 December 2028, subject to clause 5.

## 4. Delay in possession

If the Promoter fails to hand over possession by the date in clause 3, the
Promoter shall pay the Allottee compensation at ₹5 per sq ft of carpet area for
every month of delay, and this shall be the Allottee's sole remedy.

## 5. Force majeure

The Promoter shall not be liable for delay caused by force majeure, which
includes war, flood, fire, earthquake or other natural calamity, and also
includes delay in obtaining any approval from any government authority, and
shortage of labour or construction material.

## 6. Payments

All payments shall be made by cheque or bank transfer to the Nimbus Greens
Phase 1 RERA Designated Account.

## 7. Common areas and facilities

The Allottee shall have the right to use the common areas and facilities listed
in Annexure B: clubhouse with gymnasium, jogging track, children's play area and
landscaped garden.

## 8. Defect liability

If any structural defect or defect in workmanship is brought to the notice of
the Promoter within a period of one year from the date of handing over
possession, the Promoter shall rectify it without further charge.

## 9. Cancellation by the Allottee

If the Allottee cancels this agreement, the Promoter may forfeit 20% of the
price of the apartment and refund the balance without interest within twelve
months.
